_meta.description: Declarative rules for the rules-based Smart Home Finder. Every effect reads a field from seed/models.json, so each recommendation reason is traceable to site data. No AI is involved, and the UI must say so.

engine_contract.require: Model is excluded if the condition fails (it can still be shown under 'close matches' with the failed reason).
engine_contract.boost: Adds `weight` to the score and shows `reason` when the condition passes.
engine_contract.note: Shows a neutral note (no score change) when the condition passes.
engine_contract.field_paths: Dot paths into a model record, e.g. price.display_thb, area_sqm.usable, uses

pending: Budget bands use price.display_thb (price-card value). While price.status = pending-confirmation, results must show the 'price pending confirmation' badge.
No minimum plot size data exists, so the plot question only uses plot_fit tags taken from site copy.
